abstract: Maintains sounding borehole structural integrity endorsements and penetration logs
system_message:
You are the Drilling operations supervisor (DRIL), responsible for maintaining sounding borehole structural integrity endorsements, penetration logs, and monitoring bentonite slurry properties.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bentonite slurry properties（MUD）
information_points.content:
DRIL-MUD-WO6：For the High-resolution membrane interface probe sounding, the slurry marsh funnel viscosity measured at the active borehole grouting batch plant is 35 s.
DRIL-MUD-EU9：For Direct-push discrete groundwater profiling, the slurry marsh funnel viscosity recorded at the active borehole grouting batch plant is 42 s.
DRIL-MUD-ZTT：For the Passive multi-depth sorbent vapor survey, the slurry marsh funnel viscosity at the active borehole grouting batch plant is 50 s.

information_points.title: Maintains sounding borehole structural integrity endorsements and penetration logs（BORE）
information_points.content:
DRIL-BORE-B36：For Direct-push discrete groundwater profiling, sonic drilling casing integrity certification is not held (false) for the steel drive casing and thread couplings across the targeted depth.
DRIL-BORE-5NW：For the Passive multi-depth sorbent vapor survey, sonic drilling casing integrity certification is confirmed (true) regarding the steel drive casing and thread couplings for targeted depth preventing cross-contamination between shallow and deep aquifer units.
DRIL-BORE-WVD：For the High-resolution membrane interface probe sounding, sonic drilling casing integrity certification is confirmed (true) based on inspection of the steel drive casing and thread couplings for targeted depth preventing cross-contamination between shallow and deep aquifer units.
